_why: Gzipped bytes of scripts and stylesheets, measured from the build manifest by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget). Every overrun is REPORTED; the build FAILS only when the first load is more than firstLoad.blockAbovePercent over its budget. Routes and features are named by their source file, so a regrouping by the bundler does not move them. Never raise a number to make a build pass, or to sit just above it: cut the weight, or write the argument here and in the commit. docs/testing.md, 'What the bundle budget measures'.

firstLoad._note: What every page loads before its first render, /login included: the entry, the app shell, their static imports, and the British English catalogue, which src/application.tsx awaits before rendering and every deployment loads. Advisory from 2026-10-27, as in DCB Admin: over the budget is reported, and only more than blockAbovePercent over fails the build (limit 294,000). Raised from 252,100 on 2026-10-28 when the catalogue joined the count, its own reported-only budget having been raised twice and cut never. Set so the room before the build fails is unchanged: 294,000 - 254,905 measured = 39,095, against 264,705 - 225,598 = 39,107 before. 252,100 was 247,141 measured on 2026-10-14 when the catalogue left the static imports, plus 2%.

Patron requests grid._note: Raised from 470,300 on 2026-10-23, to Supplier requests' figure: the page now offers the same bulk clean up (22 Oct, with its dialogs loaded on first use) and the readable URL with columns and the last view (about 6 KB, as DCB Admin measured). 475,548 measured; 497,100 is inside the routes' measured-plus-5% rule.

American English catalogue._note: Lowered from 25,900 on 2026-10-28, when en-US became an overlay of the strings that differ from en-GB rather than a full copy (docs/theming.md, 8. Language). 3,908 measured. An en-US deployment now loads the British catalogue as well, so it downloads this much more than an en-GB one.

_notes.routes: What a page loads beyond the first load: its route file, the layout routes above it, and their static imports. Set on 2026-10-16 to what was measured plus 5%, rounded up to 100, and held: room for strings and dependency patches, not for tens of KB.
_notes.onDemand: What a feature loads beyond the first load, from its entry point. The American English overlay loads at startup only where the deployment or the user chooses en-US, on top of the British catalogue the first load counts. Excel export loads only when someone exports to Excel. The saved filters dialog loads when it is opened, and most of what it counts is already on the grid page that opens it.
